title.zh: Nvidia发布RTX Spark：基于Arm的高效PC芯片
title.en: Nvidia announces the RTX Spark, an Arm-based consumer chip family it calls “the most efficient PC chip ever built”, made on TSMC 3 in partnership with MediaTek

summary.zh: Nvidia与MediaTek合作推出基于TSMC 3工艺的RTX Spark芯片，号称“史上最高效的PC芯片”。

title.zh: Anthropic计划IPO，或于今年秋季进行
title.en: Anthropic says it has confidentially filed for an IPO, which could happen as soon as this fall, joining OpenAI and SpaceX in preparing to go public in 2026

summary.zh: Anthropic已秘密提交IPO申请，计划2026年与OpenAI和SpaceX一同上市。

title.zh: 佛罗里达州总检察长起诉OpenAI及Sam Altman
title.en: Florida AG James Uthmeier sues OpenAI and Sam Altman, seeking to hold Altman personally liable for deceptive trade practices, negligence, and public nuisance

summary.zh: 指控Altman涉及欺骗性商业行为、过失和公共妨害，寻求个人责任追究。

title.zh: Alphabet通过股权融资筹集80亿美元
title.en: Alphabet is raising $80B in equity offerings, including a $10B investment deal with Berkshire Hathaway, to help raise money for its AI spending plans

summary.zh: 包括与伯克希尔哈撒韦达成的100亿美元投资协议，用于支持AI支出计划。

title.zh: 中国发布新投资规则，加强对海外交易的监管
title.en: China issues new investment rules, expanding regulatory powers to scrutinize overseas deals involving Chinese investors, tech, and data, effective from July 1

summary.zh: 新规自7月1日起生效，扩大对涉及中国投资者、技术和数据的海外交易的审查权力。

title.zh: Jensen Huang：Nvidia新款Vera CPU被多家大公司采用
title.en: Jensen Huang says Anthropic, OpenAI, and SpaceX are among the first big users of Nvidia's new Vera CPUs, which are 1.8x faster at AI workloads than x86 chips

summary.zh: Anthropic、OpenAI和SpaceX成为Nvidia新款Vera CPU的首批用户，性能比x86芯片快1.8倍。

title.zh: Nvidia发布基于Isaac GR00T的开放人形机器人参考设计
title.en: Nvidia unveils an open humanoid reference design built on Isaac GR00T and its Jetson Thor chip, combining a Unitree H2 Plus robot and Sharpa five-fingered hands

summary.zh: 结合Unitree H2 Plus机器人和Sharpa五指机械手，搭载Jetson Thor芯片。

title.zh: Nvidia推出DGX Station for Windows桌面PC
title.en: Nvidia unveils DGX Station for Windows, a desktop PC powered by a GB300 Grace Blackwell chip with up to 748GB of memory, capable of running 1T-parameter models

summary.zh: 搭载GB300 Grace Blackwell芯片，内存高达748GB，可运行1万亿参数模型。

title.zh: Intel发布Crescent Island数据中心GPU
title.en: Intel details its Crescent Island data center GPUs, built on its Xe3P architecture and using LPDDR5X memory instead of HBM, calling them “built for agentic AI”

summary.zh: 基于Xe3P架构，采用LPDDR5X内存，专为“智能AI”设计。

title.zh: MiniMax发布M3新编码模型
title.en: Chinese AI developer MiniMax debuts M3, a new coding model that it says rivals Claude Opus 4.7, costing $0.12 per 1M input tokens, compared with $5 for Opus 4.7

summary.zh: MiniMax推出M3编码模型，声称性能可媲美Claude Opus 4.7，成本仅为Opus 4.7的1/40。

title.zh: 微软将在Build大会上发布Copilot“超级应用”和新推理模型
title.en: Sources: at Build, Microsoft plans to unveil a Copilot “super app”, a new reasoning model developed by Microsoft AI, and Windows improvements for developers

summary.zh: 微软计划在Build大会上推出一款Copilot“超级应用”，展示其AI团队开发的新推理模型，并为开发者提供Windows改进。

title.zh: Runway计划将伦敦设为欧洲总部并投资2亿英镑
title.en: AI startup Runway, most recently valued at $5.3B, plans to make London its European headquarters and invest $200M+ into the UK's AI ecosystem by the end of 2028

summary.zh: AI初创公司Runway计划到2028年底在英国AI生态系统中投资超过2亿美元，并将伦敦设为其欧洲总部。

title.zh: 法国私募股权公司Ardian与Verne合作建设AI“超级工厂”
title.en: French private equity firm Ardian partners with data center group Verne to build an up to €5B AI “gigafactory” outside Paris, targeting up to 500MW in capacity

summary.zh: Ardian与数据中心集团Verne合作，在巴黎郊外建设一座耗资50亿欧元的AI“超级工厂”，目标容量达500MW。

title.zh: Gigascale Capital完成2.5亿美元基金，支持AI初创公司
title.en: Gigascale Capital, a climate tech VC firm co-founded by former Meta CTO Mike Schroepfer, closed a $250M fund to back early-stage startups supporting the AI boom

summary.zh: 由前Meta CTO Mike Schroepfer联合创立的气候科技风投公司Gigascale Capital完成2.5亿美元基金，支持早期阶段的AI相关初创公司。

title.zh: ChatGPT前时代的初创公司面临私募市场的清算
title.en: Startups from the pre-ChatGPT era face a reckoning in private markets; PitchBook: half of US unicorns haven't raised in three years, 220+ are “fallen unicorns”

summary.zh: 根据PitchBook数据，美国一半的独角兽公司三年未融资，220多家公司已成为“堕落独角兽”。

title.zh: 以色列网络公司DriveNets完成4.1亿美元D轮融资
title.en: Israeli networking company DriveNets raised a $410M Series D led by Bessemer and Atreides at an $8.5B valuation, taking its total funding to ~$1B

summary.zh: DriveNets在Bessemer和Atreides领投下完成4.1亿美元D轮融资，公司估值达85亿美元，总融资额接近10亿美元。

title.zh: 北京Vast公司完成2亿美元融资，估值超10亿美元
title.en: Beijing-based Vast, which uses AI models to generate 3D assets from text and image prompts, raised ~$200M at a $1B+ valuation, and says it has 20M global users

summary.zh: Vast利用AI模型从文本和图像生成3D资产，已拥有2000万全球用户，最新融资2亿美元，估值超过10亿美元。

title.zh: Mecka AI完成6000万美元融资，用于机器人训练
title.en: New York City-based Mecka AI, which trains robots with human data sourced from body sensors and iPhones, raised $60M, including a $25M Series A

summary.zh: 总部位于纽约的Mecka AI通过人体传感器和iPhone数据训练机器人，完成6000万美元融资，其中包括2500万美元A轮融资。

title.zh: 量子计算初创公司Quantinuum计划IPO，目标融资14.6亿美元
title.en: SEC filing: quantum computing startup Quantinuum boosts its IPO, aiming to sell 26.5M shares for $53-$55 each, raising up to $1.46B at an up to $14.3B valuation

summary.zh: 根据SEC文件，Quantinuum计划通过IPO发行2650万股，价格区间为53至55美元，估值最高达143亿美元。

title.zh: Strava新增API访问月费并限制公开资料访问
title.en: Strava is adding an $11.99 monthly fee for developer API access and moving public profiles and fitness club listings behind authentication to combat AI scraping

summary.zh: Strava将对开发者API访问收取每月11.99美元费用，并将公共资料和健身俱乐部列表移至身份验证后，以应对AI数据抓取问题。

title.zh: 分析发现中国军方自2019年以来500多次采购Nvidia芯片
title.en: Wirescreen analysis of 3,800 Chinese military procurement records finds 500+ instances since 2019 where the PLA sought Nvidia chips, including the A100 and A800

summary.zh: 研究显示，中国军方采购记录中多次涉及Nvidia A100和A800芯片。

title.zh: 美军主导的黑客马拉松“监狱突破行动”探讨AI与武器系统整合
title.en: A look at Operation Jailbreak, a US Army-led hackathon where nine defense firms use AI to integrate weapons systems, drawing on Ukraine interoperability lessons

summary.zh: 活动吸取乌克兰战场经验，九家国防公司参与，探索AI在武器系统中的应用。

title.zh: 微软即将推出统一的Copilot超级应用
title.en: New screenshots of upcoming Copilot Super App (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 新应用整合了GitHub Copilot、Cowork和Scout等功能，提升用户采用率。
summary.en: Microsoft looks likely to debut its unified Copilot app at Build 2026. Leaked screenshots show a GitHub Copilot tab, a Cowork tab, and a tab for Scout, an always-on AI agent. The company is trying to boost weak adoption by folding scattered tools into a single home. The integration of Teams hints that Scout may be able to run remotely.

title.zh: MiniMax M3模型：支持超长上下文窗口的开源模型
title.en: MiniMax M3 (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型支持图像和视频输入，可执行桌面操作，适用于代码和代理任务。
summary.en: MiniMax M3 is an open weights model that achieves frontier-level performance on coding and agentic work. The model supports image and video input and can operate a desktop computer. It uses a new attention architecture that enables context scaling and can support ultra-long context windows of up to 1 million tokens. The model is available through MiniMax Code, the Token Plan, and MiniMax's API services.

title.zh: NVIDIA将在2026年Computex发布N1X笔记本芯片
title.en: Computex 2026 Will Be NVIDIA's Biggest Event Of The Year. Here's What To Expect (5 minute read)

summary.zh: 新芯片拥有20个ARM核心和RTX 5070级别GPU，并推出“Vera Rubin”AI平台。
summary.en: Nvidia plans to unveil its N1X laptop chip at Computex 2026, featuring 20 ARM cores and an RTX 5070 equivalent GPU, promising improved VRAM allocation for AI applications. The company will also present its "Vera Rubin" AI platform for datacenters, aiming to strengthen its position in the AI market. Nvidia's focus on Physical and Agentic AI will highlight advancements in autonomous machines and robotics, while gaming announcements seem minimal.

title.zh: Claude Opus 4.8系统卡发布
title.en: Claude Opus 4.8: The System Card (40 minute read)

summary.zh: 新版本系统卡长达244页，更新内容较小，但揭示了与Mythos的差异。
summary.en: Claude Opus 4.8, released only six weeks after Opus 4.7, comes with a 244-page system card. While the updates are incremental, there is still a lot to talk about. Its capabilities are still well behind Mythos. This post looks at the system card, what's different between the two versions, and what this reveals about Mythos.

title.zh: Bonsai Image 4B：适用于本地设备的图像生成模型
title.en: Introducing 1-bit and Ternary Bonsai Image 4B: Image Generation for Local Devices (9 minute read)

summary.zh: 1-bit和三值变体分别针对内存受限和高质量图像生成需求，支持iPhone运行。
summary.en: Bonsai Image 4B is a family of compact image-generation models that can run high-quality diffusion inference on local hardware. The 1-bit variant is for applications where memory pressure, bandwidth, and deployment footprint are the primary restraints. The ternary variant has more representational flexibility, giving it improved visual quality and prompt fidelity while remaining extremely compact. The models can run directly on an iPhone.

title.zh: Grok Build 0.1 API公测上线
title.en: Grok Build 0.1 on API (1 minute read)

summary.zh: xAI推出的模型专注于代理编程任务，支持多平台集成，提供高效的处理速度。
summary.en: xAI's grok-build-0.1 is now in public beta via the API, designed for agentic coding tasks like web development and debugging. The model processes over 100 tokens/second, costing $1 per million tokens in and $2 per million out. It integrates well with platforms like Grok Build, Cursor, and OpenClaw.

title.zh: 企业AI代理的瓶颈在于权限管理而非模型性能
title.en: The AI agent bottleneck isn't model performance — it's permissions (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Workday通过权限管理和与Gemini集成解决企业AI代理的合规性问题。
summary.en: Enterprise AI agents are struggling due to permissioning issues rather than model performance. Workday addresses this by using its system of record as the governance layer, integrating with Google's Gemini, and emphasizing agent accuracy. This setup ensures agents operate within defined user permissions, crucial for regulated sectors like HR and finance.

title.zh: 前DeepMind研究员筹集5000万美元开发科学问题AI
title.en: Ex-DeepMind researchers raised $50M to build AI that figures out which scientific questions are worth asking (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 伦敦AI实验室Inherent开发Faraday平台，专注于识别值得研究的科学问题。
summary.en: Inherent, a London-based AI lab, is building a platform called Faraday aimed at figuring out which questions are worth asking.

title.zh: OpenAI发布可信第三方AI模型评估指南
title.en: OpenAI Outlines Playbook for Trustworthy Third-Party AI Model Evaluations (4 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI于5月28日发布了一份全面指南，介绍如何对前沿AI模型（如GPT-5.5）进行可信的第三方评估。
summary.en: OpenAI published a comprehensive guide on May 28 for conducting trustworthy third-party evaluations of frontier AI models like GPT-5.5.

title.zh: Anthropic将Project Glasswing扩展至15+国家，涉及五眼联盟、北约等
title.en: Anthropic says it will extend Project Glasswing to organizations in 15+ countries, sources say giving Mythos access to Five Eyes, NATO, Samsung, SK, and others

title.zh: 微软发布Project Solara，面向代理优先设备的安卓平台
title.en: Microsoft unveils Project Solara, an Android-based platform for agent-first devices, with concept hardware and pilots planned at Best Buy, Target, and others

summary.zh: 计划在Best Buy、Target等进行概念硬件和试点项目。

title.zh: SpaceX、Anthropic和OpenAI的IPO或将为美股市场增加4万亿美元市值
title.en: SpaceX's, Anthropic's, and OpenAI's IPOs could add up to $4T in US stock market value within months, fueling concerns they could herald more capital raising

summary.zh: 引发对更多资本筹集的担忧。

title.zh: 微软发布首个高级推理AI模型MAI-Thinking-1
title.en: Microsoft debuts MAI-Thinking-1, its first advanced reasoning AI model, trained “from the ground up on clean data, without distillation from third-party models”

summary.zh: 从零开始基于干净数据训练，无第三方模型蒸馏。

title.zh: 微软推出企业AI代理Scout，基于OpenClaw构建
title.en: Microsoft announces Scout, an always-on enterprise AI agent built on OpenClaw, appearing as a Microsoft Teams contact to automate tasks like scheduling and more

summary.zh: 作为Microsoft Teams联系人出现，可自动化任务如日程安排等。

title.zh: 微软发布量子芯片Majorana 2，计划2029年推出商用量子计算机
title.en: Microsoft unveils Majorana 2, a quantum chip that it developed using AI tools for materials science, and says it will have commercial quantum machines by 2029

summary.zh: 芯片由AI工具开发，用于材料科学研究。

title.zh: Nvidia发布5500亿参数的MoE开源模型Nemotron 3 Ultra
title.en: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550B-parameter MoE open model; Artificial Analysis says it is the smartest open US model, but trails Chinese model Kimi K2.6

summary.zh: 被评为美国最智能的开源模型，但落后于中国的Kimi K2.6。

title.zh: Perplexity推出计算功能，分配任务至本地和云端模型
title.en: Perplexity unveils a Computer feature that splits tasks across local models and cloud-based models, to keep private data on-device and maximize token efficiency

summary.zh: 旨在保护隐私数据并最大化Token效率。

title.zh: AI将颠覆IT咨询行业，更多项目将基于结果定价
title.en: AI will significantly disrupt IT consultancies as AI labs build advisory arms and executives expect more projects priced based on outcome instead of by the hour

summary.zh: AI实验室建立咨询部门，企业高管预期项目定价模式将改变。

title.zh: 谷歌、Anthropic和Meta近期雇佣心理学、伦理学和哲学专家
title.en: Sources: Google, Anthropic, and Meta have hired experts in psychology, ethics, and philosophy in recent months as they expand machine consciousness research

summary.zh: 以扩展机器意识研究。

title.zh: 智谱AI计划申请在上海上市，市值约830亿美元
title.en: Zhipu AI says it plans to apply for a listing in Shanghai; Zhipu's Hong Kong-listed shares are up 10x+ since its January IPO, giving it an ~$83B market cap

summary.zh: 智谱AI自1月在香港上市以来股价上涨超过10倍。

title.zh: ARM CEO透露甲骨文和字节跳动成为新AGI数据中心CPU客户
title.en: Computex 2026: ARM CEO Rene Haas says Oracle and ByteDance are among the customers of Arm's new AGI CPUs for data centers

summary.zh: 在Computex 2026上，ARM CEO Rene Haas宣布其新AGI CPU已被多家公司采用。

title.zh: 中国将数据和算法纳入商业秘密规则
title.en: China adds data and algorithms to its trade secret rules, as part of Beijing's efforts to prevent tech leaks amid intensifying strategic competition with the US

summary.zh: 此举旨在防止技术泄露，应对与美国日益激烈的战略竞争。

title.zh: Salesforce收购CMS提供商Contentful，交易金额约10-15亿美元
title.en: Salesforce is acquiring CMS provider Contentful; a source says Salesforce paid between $1B and $1.5B, a steep discount from Contentful's $3B valuation in 2021

summary.zh: 相比2021年Contentful的30亿美元估值，此次收购价格大幅折让。

title.zh: Thrive Holdings承诺10亿美元收购本地会计公司并用AI自动化其工作流程
title.en: Thrive Capital spinoff Thrive Holdings commits $1B to acquire local accounting firms through its subsidiary, Current, and use AI to automate their workflows

title.zh: 以色列数据安全初创公司Cyera融资3亿美元，估值达120亿美元
title.en: Israeli data security startup Cyera raised $300M at a $12B valuation, after raising $400M at a $9B valuation in January

summary.zh: 此前该公司在1月以90亿美元估值融资4亿美元。

title.zh: Google为Android 12及以上版本添加诈骗检测功能
title.en: Google adds a scam-detection feature, built on RCS, to Android 12 and later that verifies whether a call is coming from the caller's actual Android smartphone

summary.zh: 该功能基于RCS技术，可验证来电是否来自实际的Android智能手机。

title.zh: Sam Altman谈OpenAI的Stargate数据中心项目及AI发展趋势
title.en: Q&A with Sam Altman on OpenAI's Stargate data center project in Saline, Michigan, coding models as the biggest AI demand driver, falling token prices, and more

summary.zh: 讨论了密歇根州Saline的Stargate项目、AI需求驱动因素及代币价格下降等话题。

title.zh: 英国开始使用SpaceX的军事化卫星网络Starshield
title.en: Sources: the UK has begun using SpaceX's militarized satellite network Starshield, making the UK among the first countries outside the US to adopt the tech

summary.zh: 英国成为美国以外首批采用该技术的国家之一。

title.zh: Qwen3.7-Plus：多模态智能代理模型
title.en: Qwen3.7-Plus: Multimodal Agent Intelligence (36 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型整合了视觉与语言，支持GUI和CLI交互，现已通过阿里云模型工作室提供。
summary.en: Qwen3.7-Plus is a multimodal agent model that unifies vision and language into a single, versatile agent foundation. It can operate as a multimodal interactive hybrid agent, seamlessly blending GUI and CLI interactions within a single agent loop. The model performs consistently across scaffolds and frameworks. Qwen3.7-Plus is now available via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

title.zh: OpenAI 和 Codex 登陆 AWS
title.en: OpenAI and Codex Reach AWS (3 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI 宣布其前沿模型和 Codex 在 AWS 上全面可用，企业可通过 AWS 的安全、治理、采购和计费流程访问这些能力。
summary.en: OpenAI announced the general availability of its frontier models and Codex on AWS. The integration allows enterprises to access OpenAI capabilities through existing AWS security, governance, procurement, and billing workflows.

title.zh: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron 3 Ultra
title.en: NVIDIA just announced the release of Nemotron 3 Ultra (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Nemotron 3 Ultra 拥有5500亿参数（其中550亿为活跃参数），是美国最智能的开源权重模型，支持 NVFP4 量化以提升推理性能。
summary.en: Nemotron 3 Ultra features 550B parameters (55B active). It is the most intelligent open weights model from the US. The model will be made available in NVFP4 quantization for higher inference performance. It scores 48 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, well ahead of the next strongest model, Gemma 4 31B, which scored 39. Nemotron 3 Ultra serves over 300 tokens per second on a pre-release Deep Infra endpoint.

title.zh: Anthropic 提交保密 IPO 注册申请
title.en: Anthropic Filed a Confidential Draft IPO Registration (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 向美国证券交易委员会提交了保密的 S-1 注册声明，计划进行首次公开募股，具体定价和股份数量尚未确定。
summary.en: Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft S-1 registration statement to the US Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering. The filing does not set pricing or share counts and remains subject to regulatory review and market conditions.

title.zh: 视频代理模型的未来：Ethan He 的见解
title.en: Why Video Agent models are next — Ethan He, xAI Grok Imagine (98 minute read)

summary.zh: Ethan He 曾领导 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos World Model 项目，后加入 xAI 并在三个月内开发了 Grok Image。他分享了关于构建前沿图像和视频系统的经验。
summary.en: Ethan He was the lead on Nvidia's Cosmos World Model. He then joined xAI and built Grok Image in three months. He has been in the center of some of the most important work in video generation, multimodal models, and real-time world models. This post contains an interview with He where he unpacks what it actually takes to build frontier image and video systems.

title.zh: 重新定义搜索为代码生成
title.en: Rethinking Search as Code Generation (25 minute read)

summary.zh: Perplexity 推出 Search as Code (SaC)，通过 SDK 让模型直接控制搜索流程，提升性能和效率，尤其在复杂任务中表现出色。
summary.en: Perplexity introduces Search as Code (SaC) to modernize search architectures by allowing models direct control over the search process via an SDK. This approach lets AI models configure search pipelines tailored to specific tasks, improving performance and efficiency over traditional monolithic systems. SaC outperformed competitors in benchmarks, especially in complex tasks like WANDR, demonstrating its robust, cost-effective agentic search capabilities.

title.zh: NVIDIA 推出 Cosmos 3 开放物理 AI 基础模型
title.en: NVIDIA Launches Cosmos 3, the Open Frontier Foundation Model for Physical AI (5 minute read)

summary.zh: Cosmos 3 是一款支持文本、图像、视频、声音和动作生成的多模态模型，采用混合变换器架构，降低数据需求和训练成本。
summary.en: Nvidia Cosmos 3 is a new leaderboard-topping open physical AI foundation model. It is a fully open omnimodel with native vision reasoning and multimodal generation across text, image, video, ambient sound, and action. The model is built on a mixture-of-transformer architecture, which pairs a reasoning transformer with an expert generation transformer. It gives developers a powerful pretrained foundation for building physical AI systems with less data and lower training costs.

title.zh: JetBrains 发布 Mellum 2 编程语言模型
title.en: JetBrains's Mellum 2 (49 minute read)

summary.zh: Mellum 2 是一个拥有 120 亿参数的 MoE 语言模型，专为编程、推理、工具使用和代理工作流优化。
summary.en: JetBrains introduced Mellum 2, a 12B-parameter MoE language model optimized for coding, reasoning, tool use, and agentic workflows.

title.zh: Alphabet 计划通过股票销售筹集 800 亿美元用于 AI 基础设施
title.en: Alphabet plans to raise $80 billion from stock sales to fund AI buildout (4 minute read)

summary.zh: Alphabet 将通过股票销售筹集资金，以应对客户对 AI 计算基础设施的空前需求，其中包括伯克希尔哈撒韦的 100 亿美元投资。
summary.en: Alphabet plans to sell $80 billion in stock to fund investments into AI compute infrastructure due to unprecedented customer demand. The raise includes $10 billion from Berkshire Hathaway, $30 billion in an underwritten offering, and $40 billion from an at-the-market offering program for Class A and Class C shares expected to begin in the third quarter. Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase, and Morgan Stanley are acting as joint book-running managers for the underwritten offering.

title.zh: 美国关闭 NVIDIA 高端芯片流向中国企业的漏洞
title.en: US moves to close the loophole letting Nvidia's top chips reach Chinese firms abroad (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 美国商务部发布新规，要求对出售给中国企业的高端芯片实施出口许可限制，旨在阻止通过海外子公司购买芯片的行为。
summary.en: The US Commerce Department has issued guidance extending export license requirements to advance chips sold to any entity headquartered in China, regardless of where that entity is physically located. This closes a loophole that allowed Chinese companies to buy Nvidia chips using a subsidiary in another country. The action is aimed at future sales and not at clawing back hardware already shipped. It doesn't affect the servicing of advanced computing equipment such as servers.

title.zh: OpenAI发布新政策建议，主张高级AI系统的网络风险评估应由CAISI主导
title.en: OpenAI diverges from Trump's AI EO in a new policy paper, proposing cyber risk evaluations for advanced AI systems be mandatory and led by CAISI, not the NSA

title.zh: Google测试新功能：允许英国网站决定是否出现在AI搜索结果中
title.en: Google says it is testing a new toggle inside its Search Console with some UK domain owners, letting them decide whether their sites appear in AI search results

title.zh: Mustafa Suleyman称微软目标成为全球前四AI实验室之一
title.en: Mustafa Suleyman says Microsoft aims to become “one of the top four labs in the world”, and “the pivotal moment was renegotiating our contract with OpenAI”

summary.zh: 微软与OpenAI重新谈判合同被认为是关键转折点。

title.zh: 阿里巴巴发布Qwen3.7-Plus多模态模型，支持100万Token上下文窗口
title.en: Alibaba releases Qwen3.7-Plus, a multimodal proprietary model with a 1M-token context window, costing $2 per 1M tokens, 60% less than the text-only Qwen3.7-Max

summary.zh: 该模型每百万Token成本为2美元，比Qwen3.7-Max低60%。

title.zh: Meta推出Meta Business Agent，助力企业在社交平台上与客户互动
title.en: Meta introduces Meta Business Agent, an AI agent that lets businesses on WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger answer customer questions, close sales, and more

summary.zh: 该AI代理可回答客户问题、完成销售等功能。

title.zh: Google邀请开发者参与机密内容试点计划以训练AI编码工具
title.en: Email: Google asked Google Play app developers to “join a confidential content offer pilot”, offering to pay for codebase access to train its AI coding tools

summary.zh: Google计划为获取代码库访问权限提供报酬。

title.zh: Google推出Gemma 4 12B：可在16GB VRAM设备上运行的多模态模型
title.en: Google introduces Gemma 4 12B, a unified, encoder-free open multimodal model that can run locally on devices with 16GB of VRAM or unified memory

summary.zh: 该模型无需编码器，支持本地运行。

title.zh: Sensor Tower：ChatGPT成为最快达到10亿月活用户的应用
title.en: Sensor Tower: ChatGPT becomes the fastest app by far to hit 1B global MAUs; ChatGPT's MAUs are up 62% YoY in Q2 to date and Claude's MAUs are up 640% YoY to 56M

summary.zh: ChatGPT月活同比增长62%，Claude月活同比增长640%至5600万。

title.zh: AI初创公司探索递归自我改进技术，致力于开发自我优化AI
title.en: How OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI startups are pursuing recursive self-improvement, in a bid to build AI that can improve itself with little to no human input

title.zh: Anthropic推出Claude合作伙伴网络服务轨道及门户网站
title.en: Anthropic unveils a Services Track for its Claude Partner Network, a ranking based on what companies built with Claude, and releases a Claude Partner Hub portal

summary.zh: 该服务轨道基于企业使用Claude构建的成果进行排名。

title.zh: 印度构建和出口主权AI模板的雄心与结构性限制的碰撞
title.en: How India's ambitions to build and export a sovereign AI template are colliding with structural constraints, including a dependence on foreign AI infrastructure

summary.zh: 印度在构建和出口主权AI模板的过程中，面临包括对外国AI基础设施依赖在内的结构性限制。

title.zh: DeepSeek计划在首轮融资中筹集约74亿美元
title.en: Sources: DeepSeek is set to raise ~$7.4B in its first funding round from investors, including Tencent and CATL, at a valuation of between ~$52B and ~$59B

summary.zh: 消息称，DeepSeek计划在首轮融资中从包括腾讯和CATL在内的投资者处筹集约74亿美元，估值在520亿至590亿美元之间。

title.zh: Lila Sciences计划以85亿美元估值筹集20亿美元B轮融资
title.en: Sources: Lila Sciences, which uses AI tools to speed up the rate of scientific discovery, is in talks to raise a $2B Series B at an expected valuation of ~$8.5B

title.zh: AI音乐初创公司Suno以54亿美元估值完成4亿美元融资
title.en: AI music startup Suno raised $400M led by Bond at a $5.4B valuation, up from $2.45B after raising $250M in November 2025, and passed 2M subscribers in February

summary.zh: Suno由Bond领投，估值从2025年11月的24.5亿美元增长至54亿美元，并在2026年2月用户突破200万。

title.zh: Apoha以3600万美元融资推出“液态智能”数据层
title.en: Apoha, which is developing a “Liquid State Intelligence” data layer to measure molecules in the real world, emerges from stealth with $36M led by Singular

summary.zh: Apoha从隐身模式中走出，开发用于测量真实世界分子的“液态智能”数据层，由Singular领投。

title.zh: AlphaSense以75亿美元估值完成3.5亿美元融资
title.en: AI market research platform AlphaSense raised $350M from Vitruvian, Accenture, and others at a $7.5B valuation, up from $4B in 2024, ahead of a possible IPO

summary.zh: AI市场研究平台AlphaSense从Vitruvian、Accenture等投资者处筹集3.5亿美元，估值从2024年的40亿美元增长至75亿美元，可能计划IPO。

title.zh: Coralogix完成2亿美元F轮融资，估值16亿美元
title.en: Boston-based software monitoring startup Coralogix raised a $200M Series F at a $1.6B post-money valuation, up from $1B+ after a $115M Series E in June 2025

summary.zh: 总部位于波士顿的软件监控初创公司Coralogix完成2亿美元F轮融资，估值从2025年6月的10亿美元增长至16亿美元。

title.zh: Collate以10亿美元估值完成9500万美元融资
title.en: Collate, whose AI tools automate paperwork for life sciences companies, raised $95M led by Redpoint at a ~$1B valuation, bringing its total funding to $125M

summary.zh: Collate开发的AI工具可为生命科学公司自动化处理文书工作，此轮融资由Redpoint领投，总融资额达1.25亿美元。

title.zh: Factorial完成1.5亿美元D轮融资，估值25亿美元
title.en: Barcelona-based HR software startup Factorial raised a $150M Series D led by General Catalyst at a $2.5B valuation to expand AI agents and grow in Germany

summary.zh: 总部位于巴塞罗那的HR软件初创公司Factorial计划利用融资扩展AI代理功能并拓展德国市场。

title.zh: Nvidia以4亿美元收购预测AI软件公司Kumo
title.en: Nvidia acquired Kumo, which sells predictive AI software to enterprises, a source says for $400M+; PitchBook: Kumo raised $37M at a $250M valuation in 2022

summary.zh: 消息称，Nvidia以超过4亿美元收购了为企业提供预测AI软件的Kumo。PitchBook数据显示，Kumo在2022年曾以2.5亿美元估值筹集3700万美元。

title.zh: 安全公司利用OpenAI的Codex发现HTTP/2炸弹漏洞
title.en: Security firm Calif says it used OpenAI's Codex to discover HTTP/2 Bomb, a remote DoS exploit affecting web servers like Nginx, Apache HTTPD, and Microsoft IIS

summary.zh: 该漏洞是一种远程拒绝服务攻击，影响Nginx、Apache HTTPD和Microsoft IIS等网络服务器。

title.zh: 多伦多大学研究人员开发基于开源AI的“蠕虫”
title.en: University of Toronto researchers claim to have developed a “worm” powered by open-source AI that exploits known flaws and tailors its attacks for each computer

summary.zh: 该蠕虫利用已知漏洞并为每台计算机定制攻击。

title.zh: 英国议员呼吁终止与Palantir的NHS合同并披露军事合同细节
title.en: In a report, UK lawmakers call on the government to end a £330M NHS deal with Palantir and disclose more details of a military contract with the company

title.zh: 欧盟委员会推出技术主权计划，包括云和AI发展法案
title.en: The EU Commission unveils its tech sovereignty package, including the EU's Cloud and AI Development Act, in a bid to reduce its reliance on US tech companies

summary.zh: 该计划旨在减少对美国科技公司的依赖。

title.zh: 谷歌公布五项AI数据中心用水承诺
title.en: Google unveils five AI data center water commitments, including becoming water positive by 2030, local infrastructure investments, and transparency about usage

summary.zh: 包括到2030年实现水资源正收益、投资本地基础设施以及用水透明化。

title.zh: 百度计划2026年分拆并上市芯片部门昆仑芯
title.en: Baidu CFO Henry He says the company plans to spin off and list its chip unit Kunlunxin in Hong Kong and Shanghai in 2026, making it more like a “neutral player”

summary.zh: 百度CFO表示此举将使昆仑芯更像一个“中立玩家”。

title.zh: 印度IT公司自2025年以来在收购上花费创纪录的71亿美元
title.en: UnearthInsight: Indian IT companies have spent a record $7.1B on acquisitions since 2025 to gain clients and market share, as AI pricing pressure weakens growth

summary.zh: 此举旨在获取客户和市场份额，同时应对AI定价压力导致的增长放缓。

title.zh: Benchmark筹集20亿美元新基金，包括首个增长基金
title.en: Sources: Benchmark raised $2B across two new funds, including a $1.25B fund for late-stage bets, its first growth fund after decades focusing on new startups

summary.zh: 其中包括12.5亿美元的后期投资基金，标志着其从专注初创企业到增长阶段的转变。

title.zh: 微软推出七款新MAI模型并与梅奥诊所合作开发AI医疗模型
title.en: Building a hill-climbing machine: Launching seven new MAI models (5 minute read)

summary.zh: 新模型支持开发者调整权重并集成到日常产品中，医疗模型将首先在梅奥诊所内部部署。
summary.en: Microsoft released seven new MAI models, enabling developers to tune model weights themselves and integrate these into everyday products. The models leverage Frontier Tuning, an approach where AI adapts to specific workflows through reinforcement learning environments. Microsoft also announced a collaboration with Mayo Clinic to develop an advanced AI healthcare model, combining clinical expertise with AI capabilities, initially deploying within Mayo before wider distribution through Azure Foundry.

title.zh: MiniMax承诺在推出1M上下文模型后发布M3权重
title.en: MiniMax promises M3 weights after 1M-context model launch (2 minute read)

summary.zh: M3模型支持1M-token上下文窗口，是首个结合前沿编码和原生多模态的开源权重模型。
summary.en: MiniMax will release the model weights and a technical report for its M3 model within the next 10 days. The new model is currently available through MiniMax Code, token plans, and an API. It has a 1M-token context window and a guaranteed 512,000-token minimum for API use. The model is the first open-weight model to combine frontier coding, native multimodality, and a 1M-token context window. MiniMax lists standard API pricing up to 512,000 input tokens at $0.60 per million input and $2.40 per million output.

title.zh: Codex 新增六大角色插件功能
title.en: Codex new Capabilities (6 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI 发布了 Codex 的新功能，包括六个针对数据分析、创意制作、销售、产品设计、股权投资和投行的角色插件。
summary.en: OpenAI released new Codex capabilities and six role-specific plug-ins for data analytics, creative production, sales, product design, equity investing, and investment banking.

title.zh: 视觉 AI 的下一个前沿：代码生成
title.en: The Next Frontier of Visual AI Is Code (11 minute read)

summary.zh: 视觉 AI 正从生成最终像素输出转向生成可编辑的代码，推动设计和 3D 建模工作流的变革，支持连续迭代和反馈。
summary.en: Visual AI is shifting from generating final pixel outputs to creating source code for editable artifacts, transforming workflows in design and 3D modeling by enabling continuous iteration and feedback. Code-native generation produces structured representations such as HTML/CSS or Blender scripts, facilitating precise edits and enhancements post-generation. This approach holds promise for industries requiring consistent 3D structures and interactive assets, with visual AI moving towards creating adaptive, editable digital artifacts rather than just static images.

title.zh: 开放与封闭模型的不同发展轨迹
title.en: Open and closed models are on different exponentials (8 minute read)

summary.zh: 尽管许多企业希望转向开放模型，但目前这些模型在分布外任务上的表现尚不够好。然而，开放模型生态系统未来将更为多样化，市场价值可能超过封闭模型。
summary.en: A lot of businesses want to switch to open models, but these models aren't yet good enough in out-of-distribution tasks. However, they will eventually catch up. The open model ecosystem will be far more diverse and numerous than the closed lab oligopoly. The total market value of the open model economy will dramatically exceed the cumulative value of OpenAI and Anthropic.

title.zh: 防止大规模 AI 推理盗窃的新方法
title.en: Preventing AI Inference Theft at Scale (5 minute read)

summary.zh: Vercel 介绍了如何通过 BotID 分析验证每个 AI 请求，减少滥用行为，解决传统速率限制不足的问题。
summary.en: Vercel outlined how attackers resell stolen AI inference by exploiting exposed endpoints and highlighted why traditional rate limits are often insufficient. The post describes an approach that verifies every AI request using BotID analysis to reduce abuse.

title.zh: 数据中心迁移至本地设备：Perplexity 推出混合推理系统
title.en: The Data Center Moves to Your Machine (4 minute read)

summary.zh: Perplexity 在 Computex 2026 发布了混合本地-云推理系统，可智能分配任务至本地或云端模型。
summary.en: Perplexity unveiled a hybrid local-cloud inference system at Computex 2026 that intelligently routes queries between on-device models for lightweight tasks and cloud-based models for complex reasoning, building on the company's earlier Personal Computer agent.

title.zh: Anthropic 面临 AI 成本争议，IPO 前景受影响
title.en: Anthropic faces AI spending backlash before IPO (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 前面临企业对高昂 AI 成本的质疑，尽管其业务表现强劲，但客户可能转向更便宜的模型或开源替代方案。
summary.en: Anthropic filed for an IPO amid growing corporate scrutiny over high AI costs, which threatens its revenue as companies reevaluate their AI investments. Businesses, Anthropic's key clients, express concerns over spending, with a survey revealing 40% experiencing cost savings below 10%. Despite Anthropic's strong performance, including surpassing OpenAI in business clients, a shift towards cheaper models or open-source alternatives poses a risk.

title.zh: Anthropic 将 Mythos 扩展至 15 个国家的 150 个组织
title.en: Anthropic expands Mythos to 150 additional organizations in more than 15 countries (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 将 Project Glasswing 扩展至 150 个合作伙伴，需满足安全要求后方可访问模型，已发现超过 10,000 个高危安全漏洞。
summary.en: Anthropic has expanded Project Glasswing to an additional 150 partners in more than 15 countries. The new partners will need to meet security requirements before gaining access to the model. Since launch, Project Glasswing partners have discovered more than 10,000 high or critical-level security flaws. Major Project Glasswing partners include Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, and Palo Alto Networks.

title.zh: GitHub 的 AI 代理计划
title.en: GitHub's plan for Agents (90 minute read)

summary.zh: GitHub COO Kyle Daigle 讨论了 AI 如何改变公司运作、他在 GitHub 使用 AI 的方式，以及 AI 时代对 GitHub 基础设施的影响。
summary.en: GitHub has been the home for software for almost two decades. Coding agents have seen massive quantities of code being shipped on the platform, which has grown 1,400% this year. This has put pressure on GitHub's infrastructure, which was designed around human developers moving at human speed. This article features an interview with GitHub COO Kyle Daigle where he discusses how AI has changed things in the company, how he uses AI to work at GitHub, why the AI era is breaking GitHub in new ways, and more.

title.zh: Anthropic详述递归自我改进的进展及其影响
title.en: Anthropic details its progress toward recursive self-improvement, and its implications, and says 80%+ of the code merged into its codebase is authored by Claude

summary.zh: Anthropic表示，其代码库中超过80%的代码由Claude生成。

title.zh: Sam Altman和Dario Amodei签署公开信，呼吁加强对合成DNA的追踪
title.en: Sam Altman and Dario Amodei are among the signatories on a public letter urging improved tracking of synthetic DNA that could be used in AI-developed bioweapons

summary.zh: 公开信警告合成DNA可能被用于AI开发的生物武器。

title.zh: 加拿大公布AI战略，计划到2031年创造25万个就业岗位
title.en: Canada unveils its AI strategy that it says will help create 250,000 jobs by 2031, with a CA$500M tech fund to invest in homegrown AI startups

summary.zh: 战略包括设立5亿加元科技基金，投资本土AI初创企业。

title.zh: 消息称Anthropic向NSA派遣工程师协助部署Mythos用于网络攻防
title.en: Sources: Anthropic has embedded around half a dozen forward-deployed engineers within the NSA to help the agency deploy Mythos for offensive cyber operations

title.zh: Anthropic准备上市并扩大Mythos的使用范围
title.en: A profile of Anthropic as it prepares to go public and broaden access to Mythos, amid criticism that commercial pressures forced it to cut corners on AI safety

summary.zh: 公司因商业压力被批评在AI安全上妥协。

title.zh: Google发布AI Edge Gallery和AI Edge Eloquent的macOS版本
title.en: Google releases macOS versions of AI Edge Gallery, which lets users run open models on their devices, and AI Edge Eloquent, an on-device voice dictation app

summary.zh: AI Edge Gallery支持在设备上运行开源模型，AI Edge Eloquent为设备端语音输入应用。

title.zh: OpenAI更新ChatGPT记忆功能，采用更高效架构
title.en: OpenAI updates ChatGPT memory with a “more capable and compute-efficient” architecture and a summary page that lets users review and steer what it remembers

summary.zh: 新增摘要页面，用户可查看和引导记忆内容。

title.zh: 阿里巴巴开放Qwen给第三方AI代理，首批合作包括肯德基和蜜雪冰城
title.en: Alibaba says it is opening Qwen to third-party AI agents, starting with KFC, Mixue, and others, and Qwen's app serves 100M+ daily lifestyle services engagements

summary.zh: Qwen应用每天服务超过1亿次生活服务交互。

title.zh: Kirkland & Ellis与Palantir达成多年合作开发AI工具
title.en: Kirkland & Ellis, the world's highest-grossing law firm, agrees to a multiyear deal with Palantir to develop an AI tool to help advise PE firms on raising funds

summary.zh: 该工具将帮助私募股权公司筹集资金。

title.zh: Harvey、Legora和Anthropic的AI工具挑战法律科技巨头
title.en: How AI tools from Harvey, Legora, and Anthropic are challenging legal tech incumbents like Thomson Reuters and LexisNexis, which are upgrading their products

summary.zh: Thomson Reuters和LexisNexis正在升级其产品以应对竞争。

title.zh: 两位美国国会议员推出跨党派AI立法，拟覆盖部分州级AI法律并要求顶级AI开发者实施风险管理计划
title.en: Two House lawmakers unveil bipartisan AI legislation that would override some state AI laws and require top AI developers to implement risk-management plans

title.zh: 法国本周获得超过1100亿欧元的AI和数据中心投资，新增约10GW计算能力，相当于约10座核反应堆
title.en: France secured €110B+ of proposed AI and data center investments this week, amounting to ~10 GW of new computing capacity, equivalent to ~10 nuclear reactors

title.zh: Meta监督委员会批评账户停用缺乏正当程序，违规标记不明确，申诉支持不足
title.en: Meta's Oversight Board says Meta's account deactivations lack due process, violations are flagged without clarity, and there's little support for appeals

title.zh: 富士康与英特尔合作开发和部署下一代AI基础设施，包括搭载英特尔至强处理器和AI芯片的服务器机架
title.en: Foxconn says it will work with Intel to jointly develop and deploy next-gen AI infrastructure, including server racks with Intel Xeon processors and AI chips

title.zh: Quantinuum在美国IPO中筹集16.8亿美元，发行2800万股，每股60美元，估值达156亿美元
title.en: Quantinuum raised $1.68B in an upsized US IPO, selling 28M shares for $60 each, priced above its marketed range of $53 to $55, valuing the company at $15.6B

title.zh: Supabase完成由GIC领投的5亿美元F轮融资，投前估值达100亿美元
title.en: Supabase, which provides backend tools for building AI apps, raised a $500M Series F led by GIC at a $10B pre-money valuation, up from $5B in October 2025

title.zh: Flourish公司开发低功耗类脑AI系统Cortex AI，获5亿美元融资，其中1亿美元来自Jeff Bezos
title.en: Flourish, which is building Cortex AI, a brain-like synthetic intelligence system that uses less power than LLMs, raised $500M, including $100M from Jeff Bezos

title.zh: 机器人初创公司Generalist完成由Radical Ventures领投的4亿美元融资，估值达20亿美元
title.en: Robotics startup Generalist, which released its GEN-1 model to complete short physical tasks in April, raised $400M led by Radical Ventures at a $2B valuation

title.zh: Airspeed完成由DN Capital领投的2000万美元A轮融资，计划用AI代理替代传统CRM仪表盘
title.en: London- and NY-based Airspeed, which aims to use AI agents to replace sales software like traditional CRM dashboards, raised a $20M Series A led by DN Capital

title.zh: Google允许美国的大型创作者和出版商申请并自定义专属搜索档案，聚合多平台内容
title.en: Google now lets big creators and publishers in the US claim and customize dedicated Search profiles to aggregate their content from multiple platforms

title.zh: 亚马逊推出新一代Proteus仓库机器人，支持AI语言功能
title.en: Amazon unveils its next-gen Proteus warehouse robot, adding AI-powered language capabilities that let workers assign it tasks, rolling out in Europe in H1 2027

summary.zh: 该机器人允许工人通过语言指令分配任务，计划于2027年上半年在欧洲推出。

title.zh: 萨提亚·纳德拉谈微软竞争地位、MAI模型、OpenAI等
title.en: Q&A with Satya Nadella on Microsoft's competitive position, MAI models, OpenAI, the software business, GitHub Copilot, Project Solara, data centers, and more

summary.zh: 纳德拉讨论了微软在软件业务、GitHub Copilot、数据中心等领域的战略和竞争力。

title.zh: Meta推迟向开发者发布新AI模型
title.en: Meta Keeps Delaying the Release of Its New AI Model to Developers (7 minute read)

summary.zh: Meta的Muse Spark模型被认为具有竞争力，但尚未被外部机构评估，发布延迟引发了对其商业化能力的质疑。
summary.en: Meta doesn't have a planned date to release its newest AI models to developers. The company is testing its API with partners and had plans to release it this month. The Muse Spark model is reportedly competitive with OpenAI and Anthropic's offerings, but it has yet to be evaluated by outside firms. The delay raises questions about how quickly Meta can monetize its massive investments in building frontier AI models.

title.zh: OpenAI与Opal Electronics合作进军AI硬件
title.en: OpenAI makes its next hardware move with Opal Electronics (2 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI投资Opal Electronics，计划推出面向创意工作的AI原生设备，标志着其硬件领域的新尝试。
summary.en: OpenAI leads a funding round for Opal Electronics, focusing on a new product line extending beyond webcams into AI-native devices for creative work. This aligns with OpenAI's push into hardware, despite delays in its own ambient computing project.

title.zh: Ideogram 4：开源文本生成图像模型
title.en: Ideogram 4 (GitHub Repo)

summary.zh: 该模型从零开始训练，支持多语言文本渲染、显式布局控制和2k分辨率图像生成。
summary.en: Ideogram 4 is an open-weight text-to-image model. It was trained from scratch and not a fine-tune of any existing model. The model introduces a new structured JSON prompting interface. It features best-in-class multilingual text rendering, deep language understanding, explicit bounding-box layout and color-palette controls, and native 2k resolution images.

title.zh: 谷歌提出“睡眠”范式以支持持续学习
title.en: Sleep for Continual Learning (24 minute read)

summary.zh: 该方法通过蒸馏和重放将短期知识整合为长期参数，并利用强化学习生成自我改进的合成课程。
summary.en: Google researchers propose a new “Sleep” paradigm that helps models consolidate short-term in-context knowledge into longer-term parameters through distillation and replay. The approach also uses a “Dreaming” stage with reinforcement learning to generate synthetic curricula for self-improvement.

title.zh: 微软推出“每美元智能”指标
title.en: Intelligence Per Dollar (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过在模型发布卡中引入平均Token使用量，微软推动企业在效率和成本效益上竞争。
summary.en: Microsoft introduces "average token usage" on model release cards, emphasizing intelligence per dollar. Models are now benchmarked on performance and the cost of achieving that intelligence. This new metric forces companies to compete on efficiency, aligning pricing with tangible outcomes like completed support cases.

title.zh: Anthropic扩展企业合作伙伴计划并筹备IPO
title.en: Anthropic Bulks Up Its Enterprise Partner Program Amid IPO Plans (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 该计划帮助第三方销售Claude产品，展示公司在扩展和商业成熟度方面的努力。
summary.en: Anthropic's Claude Partner Network is a program for third-party sellers of its AI products that helps them move more product. Firms participating in the program must meet a slate of requirements, but joining it gives companies a great deal of credibility when selling Claude to businesses. The move helps Anthropic demonstrate to the market that it is thinking about scale during a time when investors are looking for signs of business maturity. Anthropic recently filed confidentially for an IPO, putting it on a path to go public this fall.

title.zh: 摩根士丹利将开放财富管理平台给AI代理
title.en: Morgan Stanley will soon open its trillion-dollar wealth management funnel to AI agents (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 摩根士丹利允许来自数千家公司的AI代理访问其财富管理平台，如ShareWorks和Equity Edge。
summary.en: Morgan Stanley will allow AI agents from thousands of corporations to access its wealth management platforms like ShareWorks and Equity Edge.

title.zh: 特朗普考虑让美国政府持有领先AI实验室的股权
title.en: President Trump says he is weighing proposals for US government to hold equity stakes in leading AI labs, and will soon discuss the idea with their executives

title.zh: 谷歌与SpaceX达成协议，每月支付9.2亿美元获取Nvidia芯片
title.en: Filing: Google has agreed to pay SpaceX $920M per month for access to Nvidia chips as part of a cloud-services deal that runs through mid-2029

summary.zh: 协议将持续到2029年中，涉及云服务合作。

title.zh: Meta计划通过股票发行筹集数百亿美元用于AI资本支出
title.en: Sources: Meta explores a stock offering to raise tens of billions to fund AI capital expenditures, following Google's record $85B share deal; META drops 5%+

summary.zh: 消息称此举是继谷歌创纪录的850亿美元股票交易之后的行动。

title.zh: 剑桥大学开发首个由AI设计关键成分的疫苗并进行人体试验
title.en: University of Cambridge researchers say they have developed the first vaccine with a key component entirely designed by AI and subsequently trialed it in humans

title.zh: 特朗普签署国家安全备忘录，加速AI在情报和作战领域的应用
title.en: Trump signs a national security memorandum seeking to “accelerate the use of AI across intelligence and warfighting domains in line with American values”

title.zh: OpenAI确认将遵守特朗普行政命令，允许政府评估模型能力
title.en: OpenAI confirms it will comply with President Trump's EO that asks AI companies to allow the US government to assess their models' capabilities before release

title.zh: 纽约州立法机构通过一年期大型数据中心新建禁令
title.en: The NY State legislature passes a one-year moratorium on new large data centers, the first statewide ban of its kind if Governor Kathy Hochul signs it into law

summary.zh: 如果州长签署，这将成为全美首个此类州级禁令。

title.zh: AirTrunk承诺到2030年在印度投资300亿美元建设数据中心
title.en: Blackstone-backed data center operator AirTrunk commits to investing $30B in India by 2030, with plans to develop 5GW of new data center capacity in the country

summary.zh: 计划在印度开发5GW的新数据中心容量。

title.zh: AI编程初创公司Lovable计划以120亿美元估值融资
title.en: Sources: AI coding startup Lovable is in talks to raise funding at a $12B valuation, up from $6.6B in December 2025

summary.zh: 估值较2025年12月的66亿美元翻倍。

title.zh: Allen Control Systems完成2.2亿美元B轮融资，估值22亿美元
title.en: Allen Control Systems, which makes AI-powered gun turrets for shooting down drones, raised a $200M Series B led by Smash Capital at a $2.2B post-money valuation

summary.zh: 公司专注于制造用于击落无人机的AI驱动炮塔。

title.zh: 印度 Innefu Labs 完成 3000 万美元 B 轮融资
title.en: India-based Innefu Labs, which builds AI-powered software for national defense and enterprise security infrastructure, raised a $30M Series B led by Panthera

summary.zh: Innefu Labs 专注于为国家防御和企业安全基础设施提供 AI 驱动的软件，此轮融资由 Panthera 领投。

title.zh: 消息称 Apollo 和 Blackstone 为 Anthropic 提供 350 亿美元 TPU 租赁融资
title.en: Sources: Apollo and Blackstone finalized a $35B package for Anthropic to lease TPUs; Broadcom is backstopping payments on the debt's largest senior portions

summary.zh: Broadcom 将为该债务中最大的一部分高级支付提供支持。

title.zh: Anthropic 向红队开放新模型 Claude-Oceanus-V1-P
title.en: A new "claude-oceanus-v1-p" has been made available to Red Teams (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型代号 Oceanus，预计将在公开发布前进行测试，但因模型被转售事件可能影响发布时间。
summary.en: Anthropic appears to be gearing up for the public launch of a new version of Mythos that is better than Mythos Preview. A checkpoint of the model, codenamed Oceanus, was recently made available to red teamers. These programs typically begin a week before a wider launch. The program was apparently paused due to an individual in the program reselling the model via a Chinese API proxy. It is unknown whether this will impact the launch date.

title.zh: ChatGPT 推出新记忆合成系统
title.en: ChatGPT Dreaming V3 (7 minute read)

summary.zh: 该系统旨在提升长时间对话的连贯性和相关性，目前已向美国 Plus 和 Pro 用户推出。
summary.en: OpenAI introduced a new memory synthesis system for ChatGPT designed to improve freshness, continuity, and relevance over longer time horizons. The update began rolling out to Plus and Pro users in the US, with broader availability planned later.

title.zh: Anthropic 推进 AI 自主开发能力
title.en: When AI builds itself (25 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过递归自我改进，AI 系统可自主设计和开发后续版本，显著提高工程师的代码产出效率。
summary.en: Anthropic is expediting AI development by enabling AI systems to autonomously design and develop successors, a concept known as recursive self-improvement. Internal benchmarks show AI-driven processes allow typical engineers to ship eight times more code than in previous years.

title.zh: 实现大规模连续追踪智能的技术突破
title.en: How we made continuous trace intelligence possible at scale (8 minute read)

summary.zh: Braintrust 创始人分享了用于分析生产代理追踪的智能层 Topics，受 Anthropic Clio 论文启发。
summary.en: Braintrust founder Ankur Goyal lays out Topics, the intelligence layer for analyzing production agent traces at scale where million-token traces with hundreds of spans break every standard NLP tool that expects uniform document shapes. Inspired by Anthropic's Clio paper, the pipeline runs preprocess to facet to embed to cluster to name to classify, with the LLM summary doing the one job that makes the rest tractable since the raw trace never has to fit in an embedding model's context window.

title.zh: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron 3.5 内容安全模型
title.en: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety (9 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型支持多模态、多语言和可定制的企业安全执行，适用于生产审核管道。
summary.en: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety, a unified model for multimodal, multilingual, and customizable enterprise safety enforcement. It supported auditable reasoning and was designed to fit into production moderation pipelines.

title.zh: Defending Code Reference Harness：自动漏洞发现与修复
title.en: Defending Code Reference Harness (GitHub Repo)

summary.zh: 该 GitHub 仓库提供基于 Claude 的漏洞发现与修复参考实现，支持多项目的漏洞管理。
summary.en: This repository contains a reference implementation for autonomous vulnerability discovery and remediation with Claude. It can be used to build custom vulnerability pipelines based on general best practices. Anthropic offers a managed option that can find and fix vulnerabilities across multiple projects.

title.zh: Anthropic 称 80% 的生产代码由 Claude 生成
title.en: Anthropic says 80% of its new production code is now authored by Claude — how your enterprise can catch up (7 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过 Claude 的支持，工程师的代码产出量提升了 8 倍。
summary.en: Anthropic reported that 80% of its production code now comes from its AI model, Claude, leading to an 8x increase in code volume per engineer.

title.zh: Generalist AI 获得 4 亿美元融资以推进物理 AGI
title.en: Accelerating the next phase of physical AI (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 投资方包括 Radical Ventures 和 NVIDIA。
summary.en: Generalist AI secured $400 million to advance physical AGI, supported by investors like Radical Ventures and NVIDIA.
